scope: UAD probes with a calculated bound only. Non-probing trials reported separately. Fixed-margin calculations are not certified UAD probes.
precedence: A known failed premise -> out-of-model, even when other evidence is missing.
No known failed premise but missing full required histories -> unverified.
Complete required histories and every numeric premise check passes -> within-premise under the declared simulator model.
historical_change: The 1564 V4 reconstructed-compatible flags are now unverified in this stricter evidence table, not newly verified. Their old labels/results remain preserved.
distribution_assumption: Within-premise does not mean a Gaussian distribution or physical calibration can be established from a single trace; the simulation generator and declared model remain assumptions. No category is a field reliability population.
